# Original Index intake acceptance source

These original CC0-1.0 files contain only synthetic data, standard-library Python and portable reproduction metadata. They are a bounded operational acceptance fixture, excluded from the ten-Contribution release corpus and all organic-value claims. No model or provider experiment is required.

The code and six original assets preserve the bytes of the previously local private Git source `969a0fa317c1be9599cb991d045eaecd96e7d8a1`; the original report describes that earlier capture. This later public source fixture provides a real repository, evidence commit and source paths for registered internal intake. The old private Git repository is not published or renamed.

Run `python3 experiment.py` in this directory. It regenerates `inputs.json` and `outputs.json` byte-for-byte. The label-copying control is explicitly leaking and has no generalization claim. `cpu-replay-receipt.json` preserves the actual separate-root CPU recount and timings without private actor, key, case or host-path data. Full operational receipts remain in the private release evidence directory.

A research export plan must pin the actual resulting GitHub commit after this fixture lands, use the real authenticated organization and source paths, retain all reported attempts and declare generated-provenance rights separately. Creating a Synth-origin draft additionally requires a supported `research_import` grant. Nothing in these files supplies institutional identity, author consent, QA acceptance, publication or rewards.
